name: Serra Paragon
clause: Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "When ~ is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life."

needs.proposedSignature: extend the cost-alter static: { kind: 'cast-from'; zone; filter?; free?; lands?: true; oncePerTurn?: true; alternatives?: CastFromOption[]; grants?: Ability }
needs.semantics: One permission line that covers 'play a land from' and 'cast a spell from' as alternatives, may be used only once during each of your turns, and attaches a granted ability to whatever was played or cast under it. Today cast-from and play-lands-from are two unlimited always-on permissions with no rider.
needs.clause: Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "..."

needs.proposedSignature: static { kind: 'play-from-zone'; zone: 'graveyard' | 'exile' | 'library-top'; filter?: Filter; oncePerTurn?: boolean; grants?: Ability } and effect { op: 'cast-from-zone'; target: TargetSpec; zone: SetZone; free?: boolean }
needs.semantics: A permission to play/cast cards from another zone, optionally limited to once per turn and optionally granting the object an ability while it is played this way; plus the one-shot 'you may cast that card' form an activated ability uses.
needs.clause: 'Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell ...' / 'you may cast that card'

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'grant-ability'; target: TargetSpec | Ref | 'creatures-you-control'; ability: Ability; duration: 'eot' | 'permanent' } (widen the existing source-only form)
needs.semantics: Grant a quoted ability to chosen objects for a duration, layer 6, instead of only to the source permanently.
needs.clause: target creature ... gains trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
